localAI.heading: Local AI, on my own hardware
body: I run language models on my own hardware. Right now that's a quantised Qwen 3.8 27B build, served through BeeLLama to the OpenWebUI instance on my homelab. It's how I'm learning to deploy LLMs properly and to understand what's going on underneath: inference, context management and serving.

I mix local and cloud-hosted models in my own projects too. The main one is a Discord bot that chats in text channels and joins voice calls, with the aim of feeling like a regular member of the server. Building it means writing code that copes with both small and large models, which can react to the same prompt very differently.

more: ...and plenty more across the homelab and VPS instances. These are just the ones I'd miss first.
